zh.title: 東京豪雨影響交通 華航免收成田羽田退改手續費
zh.summary: 受東京豪雨影響，華航宣布8月13至14日成田與羽田出發機票免收退改手續費。
body: 受日本東京地區及千葉縣豪雨影響，中華航空（華航）宣布針對2026年8月13日至14日由東京成田機場或羽田機場出發的機票，提供退改票免收手續費作業。
華航表示，凡持有上述指定日期與航點機票的旅客，若更改訂位至2026年9月4日（含）之前的航班，或是辦理退票，均可免收手續費及未登機費。
華航指出將持續關注東京天氣狀況並與機場保持聯繫。受影響旅客可透過原開票旅行社、華航客服中心或各地分公司協助調整行程，並建議利用官網與行動應用程式查詢最新航班動態。

en.title: China Airlines Waives Ticket Rebooking and Refund Fees for Tokyo Flights
en.summary: China Airlines waives fees for Tokyo Narita and Haneda departures on August 13-14 following heavy rain.
body: China Airlines has announced a fee waiver for ticket changes and refunds following heavy rainfall in Japan's Chiba Prefecture and the broader Tokyo area. The measure applies to passengers holding tickets departing from Tokyo's Narita Airport or Haneda Airport on August 13 and August 14, 2026.
According to the carrier, eligible passengers who rebook their flights to on or before September 4, 2026, or opt for a full refund, will be exempt from handling fees and no-show penalties.

China Airlines stated that it is closely monitoring weather conditions in Tokyo and maintaining close contact with local airport authorities. Passengers are advised to contact their issuing travel agency, customer service centers, or local branch offices for itinerary adjustments, and to check flight updates via the airline's website, mobile app, or SMS notifications.
